scripts.lint: eslint public backend tests scripts/*.mjs && node scripts/check-css.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write public/*.{js,mjs,css,html} backend/*.mjs tests/*.{mjs,cjs} *.json scripts/*.mjs eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check public/*.{js,mjs,css,html} backend/*.mjs tests/*.{mjs,cjs} *.json scripts/*.mjs eslint.config.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && python3 scripts/update-assets.py --check && npm test
